What to look for

Price: General pest control typically starts around ₹800–₹2,000, depending on flat size and infestation. Get a written quote.

Coverage: Cockroaches, ants, mosquitoes, and rodents if needed.

Warranty: Prefer a free revisit or 30–45-day guarantee.

Safety: Ask about chemicals, drying time, pets, children, and food-storage precautions.

Apartment access: Confirm kitchen, bathrooms, drains, cracks, and whether follow-up visits cost extra.
